[[Category:Killycurragh Townland, Derryloran Parish, County Tyrone]]
== Biography ==
John was born about 1838. His father was [[Glasgow-1654|David Glasgow]]
(although it is possible there were more than one David Glasgow - we have not finalized this yet).

On 26 Jan 1865 at Oritor Presbyterian, he married Jane Bell of Ballynasollus, daughter of Richard Bell, farmer.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/7de79d3055078 John Glasgow, Jane Bell, 1865, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

He passed away 14 Dec 1901 at Killycurragh, age 63. Attended by Richard Glasgow, son.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/144d1c3545464 John Glasgow, 1902, Cookstown, 63] at Irish Civil Registration - Deaths</ref>
A marriage for John Glasgow and Bell was registered on 26 January 1865 in the Cookstown district.<ref>[https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/marriage GRONI civil marriage index], 26 January 1865, Cookstown district, M/1865/L1/1132/1/151.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1654]] is assessed at 94% (proved). John’s 1865 marriage account gives David as father, and James’s funeral expressly identifies John as a brother. Their shared Killycurragh context makes the selected David identity strong despite unresolved wider grouping.

Held citation and associated narrative supports this specific paternal assessment; no original was newly inspected.

Next useful test: Compare John’s father occupation with James’s 1855 entry.

Source basis already held: [https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/7de79d3055078 John Glasgow, Jane Bell, 1865, Cookstown (https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/7de79d3055078) at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


Possible daughter: [[Glasgow-1760|Elizabeth Jane Glasgow (abt.1863-)]] gives her father as "John Glasgow, Killycurragh", however Elizabeth has an unmarried aunt Jane Glasgow living with her in the census.

[[Glasgow-1727|Jane (Glasgow) Ferguson (abt.1828-1901)]]'s daughter Mary's funeral seems to list John's children as cousins.
